title: release cutover checklist - daily scratchpad
body:
Purpose:
Quick scratchpad for release cutover (production deploy) on 2026-03-19. Mostly my personal running TODOs and comms drafts - will convert to formal runbook if anything diverges.

Top-level owners (on-call/runners):
- Release lead: Jordan Lee (me) - primary coordinator
- Deploy engineer: Samira Patel - kicks off deploy, monitors workers
- DB migration owner: Riley Chen - holds migration lock, runs schema job
- SRE pager: oncall-sre@redwood.com (alerts)

Pre-cutover (T-60 -> T-10) checklist:
- [ ] Confirm release tag and PR list (all green) - PR bundle: platform@4821, api@1298, console@540
- [ ] Verify canary results in staging (latency, error rate) - staging: api-staging-green (observability OK)
- [ ] Confirm capacity reservation for dedicated pools (redwood-dedicated-prod) - JIRA: RED-1234
- [ ] Ensure feature flags toggles ready (FF: new-routing-v2) - toggle owner: ops-team
- [ ] Notify #releases Slack channel 30m before cutover (template below)
- [ ] Post to stakeholders email list at T-10 with expected downtime 0m (no downtime)
- [ ] Take last pre-cutover prod snapshot for quick rollback: snapshot id = prod-snap-20260319-01

Backport / hotfix list (must be merged before cutover):
- PR 4809: fix-memory-leak in batcher - status: merged -> awaiting CI -> assigned to Samira
- PR 4814: regression fix for tokenizer edge case - status: needs-review (blocking) -> owner: Mateo
- PR 4821: routing policy fallback logic (main release PR) - status: merged -> released to canary

Cutover step-by-step (T=0 is deploy start):
- T+0: Create release tag and trigger deploy pipeline (Samira)
- T+2: Validate deploy pipeline kicked off, monitor job logs (Jordan)
- T+5: Verify web / api pods come up on new image (kubectl rollout status) (Samira)
- T+8: Smoke test: /health, simple generation sample, embeddings endpoint check (Jordan)
- T+10: Run canary traffic ramp to 10% then 50% (controlled via traffic-router) (Riley)
- T+20: If canary stable, promote to 100% traffic (release lead)
- T+25: Run post-deploy automated regression tests (suite: reg-smoke-2026-03)

DB migration (if applicable):
- Migration window scheduled: 2026-03-19 12:30 PT
- Migration steps: pre-check -> run migration script -> verify row counts & indexes -> post-verify
- Migration owner: Riley Chen (do not run migration until canary is stable)
- Rollback: have migration rollback script in repo at tools/migrations/rollback-20260319.sql

Communication templates:
- Slack (30m prior):
  "Heads-up: Deploy for release v2026-03-19 starts in 30m. No customer-visible downtime expected. Monitoring: #platform-observability. Runbook: CONFLUENCE-876. TL;DR: canary -> promote if green. Jordan (release lead)"
- Slack (on start):
  "Deploy started for v2026-03-19 - CI pipeline running. I'll post canary results in ~10m. If you need to join voice: +1 415 555 0140 (bridge: 867-5309)."
- Post-mortem trigger (if errors > threshold): open RED-incident with priority P1 and ping execs list

Rollbacks and fallbacks:
- If canary error rate > 1% or latency > 2x baseline: pause promotion and revert to previous image (kubectl rollout undo)
- If DB migration fails halfway: run rollback script and restore snapshot prod-snap-20260319-01 (follow DR procedure)
- Fallback model: route traffic to stable-model-vA until new version fixed

Quick validation checklist (post-100%):
- [ ] Synthetic generation sample (100 prompts) - compare perf and tokens
- [ ] Embeddings sanity check (5 queries)
- [ ] Key API endpoints sampling at 1m intervals for 15m
- [ ] Monitor token billing spike unusual patterns

Open questions / notes to self:
- Need final sign-off from security on new KMS key usage (Samira following up with secops)
- Confirm Dedicated pool autoscaler policy change has already been applied (PR/conv?)
- Should we include a pre-warm step for KV caches if cold start risk is high? (test in staging)

Post-release follow-ups (T+1h, T+24h):
- T+1h: Quick retrospective - collect any incidents and immediate tuning items (Jordan)
- T+24h: Create release summary and post to #releases and release notes page (assign: Samira)
- T+72h: Schedule performance regression review if any metric drift observed (assign: Riley)

Misc scratch notes (todo later):
- Add checklist items to Confluence runbook (CONFLUENCE-876)
- Draft short customer-facing blurb for status page if we changed behavior (Samira)

EOF
